description: GTFS -Transport - Via Corsica- Corté à la vallée de la Restonica -Ligne C13 is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Collectivité de Corse. GTFS Ligne C13 qui relie Corté à la Vallée de la Restonica Le fichier GTFS est disponible ici: Vous trouverez dans ce jeu de données un export du réseau de la ligne C13 qui relie Corté à la vallée de la Restonica au format standard GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification), comportant neuf fichiers (agency, calendar ... Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Transport & Mobility. Its keywords are gtfs, Corté, restonica, Ligne C13, CDC. The portal shows 17 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-04-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
